issue.title: sase-core stitch landed unformatted code on master; fmt gate only went red post-push
issue.description:
sase-core master accepted a commit that fails the repo's own fmt gate, and downstream
agent workspaces inherited the red gate.

Commit 3fa0a542e67bf838d78e4102f6c72d810f35facd ("fix(continuation): decouple retention
run cap from MAX_NODES via new MAX_RETENTION_RUNS constant", SASE_TYPE=stitch,
SASE_AGENT=bbugyi200.athena.ar, authored 2026-09-13 17:56 EDT) landed on
gh:sase-org/sase-core master with test code in
crates/sase_core/src/continuation/retention.rs that fails `./scripts/check.sh fmt-check`
(single-line `run(...)` calls that rustfmt rewraps). sase-core CI (ci.yml) runs
`check.sh fmt-check` on master pushes, so the push turned master CI red *after* landing
— nothing blocked it: the athena stitch flow evidently pushed without local
`just check` passing (or its rustfmt disagreed with the pinned toolchain), and post-push
CI redness does not stop a landing.

Observed impact: ~1.5h later, monitor 89dp49ttb35n (lane sase-xe.16.11.7.15.3 on
apollo) ran `just check` in a fresh sase-core clone at that master and failed in 7s on
the inherited fmt diffs — a gate failure the phase worker did not cause (its own dirty
files never touched retention.rs). The breakage was fixed in passing by d0ec62c
("feat(fleet): publish remote renderer parity fields", 2026-09-14 00:11 UTC), so master
is green again; the remaining work is the gap itself.

Investigate and close the gap:
1. Reconstruct how the athena agent's stitch landed without fmt passing (athena-side
   verification skipped? rustfmt/toolchain drift vs rust-toolchain.toml? stitch hook
   ordering?).
2. Decide and implement the guard: e.g. sase-core stitch hooks must run
   `./scripts/check.sh fmt-check` (cheap, seconds) before push, or the landing flow
   must respect per-SHA CI status before declaring success.
3. Verify a deliberately unformatted stitch attempt is refused or surfaced loudly.

task_type_fields.impact: Every downstream agent workspace pulling sase-core master inherits a failing just check gate; broke monitor 89dp49ttb35n's fleet-wire-parity gate run on apollo and cascaded into a degraded follow-up launch
